Expandable Panel

An expandable panel is a self-contained card whose header toggles a body region. It is the ideal building block for settings groups, help sidebars and filter drawers.

Basic Expandable Panel

A .zak-expandable-panel wraps a .zak-expandable-panel-header (the toggle) and a .zak-expandable-panel-body collapse target.

Wire your site to a custom domain for branding and TLS out of the box. Add up to 10 domains on the Pro plan.
HTML
<div class="zak-expandable-panel zak-expandable-panel-active" data-zak-expandable>
    <button class="zak-expandable-panel-header" type="button">
        Custom domains
        <svg class="zak-icon" ...></svg>
    </button>
    <div class="zak-collapse-target zak-collapse-active">
        <div class="zak-expandable-panel-body">Wire your site...</div>
    </div>
</div>

Programmatic Control

Drive panels from buttons elsewhere in the page with zak.collapse.open/close, or listen to open/close events.

Use the inline JavaScript buttons above and the zak.collapse API to toggle this panel.
HTML
<button onclick="zak.collapse.open('#ep5Body')">Open</button>
<button onclick="zak.collapse.close('#ep5Body')">Close</button>

<div class="zak-expandable-panel" data-zak-expandable>
    <button class="zak-expandable-panel-header">...</button>
    <div class="zak-collapse-target" id="ep5Body">
        <div class="zak-expandable-panel-body">...</div>
    </div>
</div>

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
/* Class Summary */
.zak-expandable-panel        /* Self-contained card */
.zak-expandable-panel-active /* Open state on the card */
.zak-expandable-panel-header /* Full-width toggle row */
.zak-expandable-panel-body   /* Toggleable content region */
.zak-collapse-target         /* Height-animated wrapper */
.zak-collapse-active         /* Expanded wrapper */

/* Variables used */
--zak-surface                /* Panel background */
--zak-border                 /* Panel border */
--zak-radius-lg              /* Rounded corners */
--zak-transition-medium      /* Height animation */

JavaScript

HTML
// Data attributes (automatic)
//   data-zak-expandable   bind header toggle & body collapse

// The header toggles the first .zak-collapse-target sibling;
// programmatic control goes through the collapse API:
zak.collapse.open('#myBody');
zak.collapse.close('#myBody');
zak.collapse.toggle('#myBody');

// Events on the body element
body.addEventListener('zak:open', function () {});
body.addEventListener('zak:close', function () {});
body.addEventListener('zak:toggle', function (e) {
    console.log('expanded?', e.detail.open);
});

Accessibility

  • The header is a real <button> so it is keyboard focusable and announces expand/collapse via aria-expanded.
  • Wire aria-controls and aria-labelledby between header and body for screen readers.
  • Keep the header label concise; the body may hold any rich content.
  • Prefer a <details>/<summary> component when a no-JS fallback matters more than styling consistency.
